title: 美联储新主席坚持沟通策略 市场误解引发波动
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: What are your thoughts of this pace in the FT this morning on Kevin Walsh?
segments.zh: 您对今早FT上关于Kevin Walsh的这篇文章有何看法？

segments.en: Well, my initial thought would be pretty much like everybody probably on Wall Street that it's damaged control by the Fed, an effort to kind of keep the markets from overreacting to the press
segments.zh: 我的初步想法可能和华尔街大多数人一样，这是美联储的危机公关，试图防止市场对沃什的新闻发布会及随后的批评反应过度。

segments.en: conference that Walsh had and the criticism he's received since then. I think one of the things that's happened is that people on Wall Street have misunderstood a little bit of what Walsh is
segments.zh: 我认为发生的一件事是，华尔街的人们有点误解了沃什的言论。

segments.en: talking about he wants to get rid of the forward guidance such as we will keep this rate unchanged until we get to ex date or ex condition in the economy versus if inflation continues to rise
segments.zh: 他想取消前瞻性指引，比如“我们将保持利率不变，直到达到某个日期或经济条件”，而不是“如果通胀继续上升，我们将不得不考虑采取什么行动”，后者是反应函数。

segments.en: we will have to consider what we're going to do which is the reaction function and those two things have gotten confused with people on Wall Street. On the other hand Walsh is kind of
segments.zh: 这两件事在华尔街被混淆了。另一方面，沃什在谈到市场应关注球而不是裁判时，有点失策。

segments.en: missed the ball when he's talked about the market should keep its eye on the ball rather than the referee. The Fed's not the referee. The Fed is a player in the game and no matter what he wants
segments.zh: 美联储不是裁判，美联储是比赛中的球员，无论他希望怎样，你总是会预期美联储的行动，因为美联储的反应会改变你模型中的收益率。

segments.en: you're always going to be anticipating what the Fed is going to do because the Fed's reactions are going to change the yields that you're factoring into your models. So there's a little bit on both
segments.zh: 所以双方都有点问题，也许沃什试图在杰克逊霍尔会议前平息事态，以便他能进一步解释。

segments.en: sides here and maybe Walsh is trying to calm things down until he can explain more at Jackson Hole.
segments.zh: 双方都在观望，沃什可能在杰克逊霍尔会议前先缓和局势。
